13: /-!
14: # Invertibility of factorials
15: 
16: This file contains lemmas providing sufficient conditions for the cast of `n!` to a (semi)ring `A`
17: to be a unit.
18: 
19: -/
20: 
21: public section
22: 
23: namespace IsUnit
24: 
25: open Nat
26: section Semiring
27: 
28: variable {A : Type*} [Semiring A]
29: 
30: theorem natCast_factorial_of_le {n : ℕ} (hn_fac : IsUnit (n ! : A))
31:     {m : ℕ} (hmn : m ≤ n) : IsUnit (m ! : A) := by
32:   obtain ⟨k, rfl⟩ := exists_add_of_le hmn
33:   clear hmn
34:   induction k generalizing m with
35:   | zero => simpa using hn_fac
36:   | succ k ih =>
37:     rw [← add_assoc, add_right_comm] at hn_fac
38:     have := ih hn_fac
39:     rw [Nat.factorial_succ, Nat.cast_mul, Nat.cast_commute _ _ |>.isUnit_mul_iff] at this
40:     exact this.2
41: 
42: theorem natCast_factorial_of_lt {n : ℕ} (hn_fac : IsUnit ((n - 1)! : A))
43:     {m : ℕ} (hmn : m < n) : IsUnit (m ! : A) :=
44:   hn_fac.natCast_factorial_of_le <| le_sub_one_of_lt hmn
45: 
46: /-- If `A` is an algebra over a characteristic-zero (semi)field, then `n!` is a unit. -/
47: theorem natCast_factorial_of_algebra (K : Type*) [Semifield K] [CharZero K] [Algebra K A] (n : ℕ) :
48:     IsUnit (n ! : A) := by
49:   suffices IsUnit (n ! : K) by
50:     simpa using this.map (algebraMap K A)
51:   simp [isUnit_iff_ne_zero, n.factorial_ne_zero]
52: 
53: end Semiring
54: 
55: section CharP
56: 
57: variable {A : Type*} [Ring A] (p : ℕ) [Fact (Nat.Prime p)] [CharP A p]
58: 
59: theorem natCast_factorial_iff_of_charP {n : ℕ} : IsUnit (n ! : A) ↔ n < p := by
60:   have hp : p.Prime := Fact.out
61:   induction n with
62:   | zero => simp [hp.pos]
63:   | succ n ih =>
64:     -- TODO: why is `.symm.symm` needed here!?
65:     rw [factorial_succ, cast_mul, Nat.cast_commute _ _ |>.isUnit_mul_iff, ih.symm.symm,
66:       ← Nat.add_one_le_iff, CharP.isUnit_natCast_iff hp]
67:     exact ⟨fun ⟨h1, h2⟩ ↦ lt_of_le_of_ne h2 (mt (· ▸ dvd_rfl) h1),
68:       fun h ↦ ⟨not_dvd_of_pos_of_lt (Nat.succ_pos _) h, h.le⟩⟩
69: 
70: end CharP

have hj : j.val ≤ ell lam := Nat.le_of_lt_succ j.isLt

arguments.proof:
letI : Fact (Nat.Prime p) := ⟨h_H001⟩
letI : CharP K p := h_H002
have hcast : (ell lam : ℤ) = lam := Int.toNat_of_nonneg h_H003.1
have hlt : ell lam < p := by omega
have hfac : ∀ r : ℕ, r ≤ ell lam → (r.factorial : K) ≠ 0 := by
  intro r hr
  have hu : IsUnit (r.factorial : K) :=
    (IsUnit.natCast_factorial_iff_of_charP (A := K) p (n := r)).2 (lt_of_le_of_lt hr hlt)
  exact hu.ne_zero
have hcoeff : ∀ j : Idx lam, (coeff lam j : K) ≠ 0 := by
  intro j hj
  have hid := @yui_aux_0001 p K instK lam V instV instCV x y h v M h_H001 h_H002 h_H003 j
  have hz : ((ell lam).factorial : K) = 0 := by
    rw [hj, zero_mul, zero_mul] at hid
    exact hid.symm
  exact hfac (ell lam) (le_refl _) hz
refine ⟨hfac, hcoeff, ?_⟩
classical
simpa only [coeffProd, Nat.cast_prod] using
  (Finset.prod_ne_zero_iff.mpr (fun j (_ : j ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset (Idx lam))) => hcoeff j) :
    (∏ j : Idx lam, (coeff lam j : K)) ≠ 0)
